title: VERITAS Divergence Event
description: Eight-attribute event contract per V1.1.1.1 §3.2.3. Vendored verbatim from VERITAS MVP. Sponsor Ruling 31 May 2026: do NOT hand-reimplement; this file is the single contract source for the WorkCaptain adapter. Switch to a published VERITAS package dependency when available; remove this vendored copy then.

event_id.description: Idempotency key (UUIDv4 recommended). Dedup on at-least-once delivery.

destination_platform.description: Destination backend id for cross-platform flows; null otherwise.

counterparty_ref.description: Counterparty-of-reference identity where applicable; null where N/A.

field_set.description: Schema reference + list of fields transmitted.

mode.description: Mode-D events emit to VERITAS only; Mode-A regulated-provenance events additionally write to the CERTUS Trust Ledger. Mode-D MUST NOT write to Trust Ledger.

severity.description: Set by the severity classifier at the classify step; null before classification.

provenance.description: Mode-D-tagged provenance metadata; agent identity + version where relevant.
